description_en: Deletes a file from DataStudio. If the file has been committed, an asynchronous process is triggered to delete the file in the scheduling system. The value of the DeploymentId parameter returned is used to call the GetDeployment operation to poll the status of the asynchronous process
description_zh: 调用DeleteFile删除数据开发中的文件。如果文件已经提交过，那么DeleteFile API会同时触发一个异步在调度系统删除的流程，需要用DeleteFile  API返回的DeploymentId继续调用GetDeployment轮询被触发的异步删除流程的状态
name: DeleteFile

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to view the workspace name.

You must specify one of the ProjectId and ProjectIdentifier parameters to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID of the file
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。

该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the file ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID，您可以使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

DeploymentId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can troubleshoot errors based on the ID
DeploymentId.description_zh:
如果文件已经提交过，那么DeleteFile接口会同时触发一个异步在调度系统删除的流程，需要用DeleteFile接口返回的DeploymentId继续调用GetDeployment轮询被触发的异步删除流程的状态。

如果该字段为空，则说明文件已经删除完毕，无需继续轮询

ErrorCode.description_en: The ID of the file. You can use the ListFiles interface to query the ID of the corresponding file

ErrorMessage.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails

HttpStatusCode.description_en:
The ID of the deployment task that deploys the file. If the file has been committed, an asynchronous process is triggered to delete the file in the scheduling system. The value of this parameter is used to call the GetDeployment operation to poll the status of the asynchronous process.

If this parameter is empty, the file is deleted and the polling is not required

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
